This class will require basic knowledge of biology.
授業概要
遺伝子レベルの生物多様性創出のメカニズム、多様化、適応進化の遺伝的基盤を理解するための諸理論を修得する。本講義では、分子系統学、集団遺伝学に関連する教科書の講読と討論を行う。
This class will provide an introduction to the fields of population genetics and molecular phylogeny. I'll be giving lectures on major concepts, models, and methods in these fields. We will discuss some articles on plant evolution from the original scientific literature.

全体の教育目標
This class aims to understand the theories related to evolutionary genetics necessary to understand the mechanisms that create and maintain genetic diversity and acquire the basic knowledge and research skills necessary to conduct related research.
